definitions.gloss: remarkable feat, great achievement, brilliant accomplishment
definitions.explanation: An impressive accomplishment that deserves praise and admiration. Used when someone achieves something extraordinary or sets a new record.

examples.japanese: これは{歴史的|れきしてき}な{快挙|かいきょ}だ。
{日本人|にほんじん}{初|はつ}の{快挙|かいきょ}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: They accomplished a feat that was a first for a Japanese person.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{選手|せんしゅ}が{世界|せかい}{大会|たいかい}で{金|きん}メダルを{獲得|かくとく}するという{快挙|かいきょ}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: A young athlete accomplished the remarkable feat of winning a gold medal at the world championships.

notes:
USAGE:
A strongly positive word used to celebrate exceptional achievements. Very common in sports reporting and news about record-breaking accomplishments. Often used with {達成|たっせい}する (to achieve) or {成|な}し{遂|と}げる (to accomplish).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快挙|かいきょ}を{達成|たっせい}する: to achieve a remarkable feat
- {快挙|かいきょ}を{成|な}し{遂|と}げる: to accomplish a great achievement
- {歴史的|れきしてき}{快挙|かいきょ}: a historic achievement
- {前人|ぜんじん}{未踏|みとう}の{快挙|かいきょ}: an unprecedented feat
